subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. The hydroponics bay has its first crop up, forty racks of it, and every rack needs a label. Michelle has had a code stencilled on each, to the trial standard. Samuel has been scraping the stencils off with a thumbnail and writing the names of villages back home. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Names on the Racks). Read the version's text for what must be visible.
